duration.text: The Chinese Language Program at Hangzhou City University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Applicants are required to upload scanned copies of the following application documents to the application system. 1. Non-criminal record certificate issued by the local police force. 2.A letter of financial support or bank statements of the last six months from parents (including guardians). 3. Application form, passport, transcripts, high school graduation certificate or notarized documents (those who have not graduated at the time of application can provide pre-graduation certificate). 4. HSK4 Score Report (for Chinese-taught program applicants) 5. TOEFL IBT or lELTS Score Report (if available) (for English-taught program applicants whose native language is not English) 6. Physical examination form for foreigners (medical examination results valid for 6 months)7. A passport-size electronic photo taken in the past three months. 8. Other documents that may be required by HZCU to make corrections or submit.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens who are aged 18 or above, physically and mentally healthy, of good character, and willing to abide by the laws and regulations of the People' s Republic of China and HZCU' s rules and regulations. 2. Hold a valid foreign passport and have graduated from high school.
